summary: Markdown applies one GitHub-like HTML policy to normal and fallback rendering: caught render failures use the already-filtered mdast, and delimiter floods use the same CommonMark/GFM parser with attention resolution disabled instead of a second Markdown scanner. Fallbacks render approved text and literal code as escaped text; a failure before the filtered tree exists shows no source. Raw pre/code retains its words, details disclose, links allow http(s) and document references, images wait for consent, and nesting is capped at 32

replay.detail: Web UI only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: Web UI only; no wire, protocol, runtime or client changes.
